dialogues.text: #Oh, right. Help me take care of these, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: I'd like my hands free to rain hellfire down on Enjou the next time he shows his ugly face.

dialogues.speaker: Leyla
dialogues.text: Hello, you two. Is something the matter?

dialogues.speaker: Leyla
dialogues.text: #Huh!? You... You're Paimon, travel companion of the great hero {NICKNAME}!

dialogues.speaker: Leyla
dialogues.text: I never thought I'd run into such a celebrity here. Is this what happiness feels like?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, so you know about us? Hehe, it's kinda embarrassing to hear you talk like that.

choices.text: Did I give you my autograph?

response.speaker: Leyla
response.text: Oh, nothing like that. It's just that I'm studying under Master Ororon, and he's told me many tales about you two... Ack! Pardon my manners, I didn't even introduce myself! I'm Leyla, and I'm from the Masters of the Night-Wind.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ooh, Ororon! Wait... Did you say "Master" Ororon? When did he become a teacher?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Aaand... does Ororon know about this?

response.speaker: Leyla
response.text: Well! It's something of a... "one-sided teaching relationship."

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So he doesn't even know he's your teacher!? What kind of a student are you, then?

response.speaker: Leyla
response.text: *cough* I'm a little embarrassed to bring that up... I used to be a spirit-duffer — someone with no spiritual sensitivity. I was a disgrace to my tribe, essentially...

response.speaker: Leyla
response.text: But I didn't want to give up and accept my fate. I tried to brute-force my way through like a fool, and it nearly cost me my soul...

response.speaker: Leyla
response.text: But in the end, Master Ororon and the great shaman Citlali saved me.

response.speaker: Leyla
response.text: In a way, my brush with death was a blessing in disguise. After the incident, I became able to sense spirits, and that's when Ororon started teaching me a few spells. From that day onward, I've treated him as my master.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What a story... Well, Paimon's glad everything turned out okay! Since you're friends with Ororon, and we're friends with Ororon, Paimon guesses that makes us friends, too!

response.speaker: Leyla
response.text: Master often calls me "friend" as well, but I won't have it. Master is Master, and Master's Granny is Master Granny. That's just how things are.

response.speaker: Leyla
response.text: #As for you, most venerable {NICKNAME}, I know that you are friends with the great shaman Citlali... Which makes you my Master {M#Gramps}{F#Granny} too!

response.speaker: Leyla
response.text: I'm afraid it would be discourteous of me to address you simply as "friend."

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Sounds to Paimon like you picked up a lot more than just mystic arts from Ororon...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Okay... let's get back to business.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah! We're actually here to ask for your help, Leyla!

response.speaker: Leyla
response.text: Help? From me? Whatever task you entrust to me, I shall fulfill it to the best of my abilities!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: You explain to Leyla what happened earlier.

response.speaker: Leyla
response.text: I see... So, you think he's being possessed?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: That's right. What's your take on the situation?

response.speaker: Leyla
response.text: The Easybreeze Holiday Resort is indeed a location with vibrant spiritual energies, I could sense that as soon as I arrived. So it wouldn't be amiss to assume that some invisible entity could have been involved...

response.speaker: Leyla
response.text: Can you take me to that spot with the swing you mentioned earlier? I'd like to confirm a few things.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Sure thing, Leyla! We'll show you the way!

choices.text: Did I take a photo with you?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We found three reports... and they're all incredible!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... Looks like this is the last one nearby. They seem to like us a lot, huh? They're not scared at all!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Time to head back to the huts!

dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: #Huh? {NICKNAME}? Paimon?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Citlali! What are you doing here!

dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: I'm just as surprised as you two. But it's a welcome surprise.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm happy to see you too, Citlali.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Were you also invited to the resort to kick back and relax?

dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: Hmph. If I wanted an "easy breezy" day, I'd have just stayed in bed...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Are you just acting cute?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, you're here because of Leyla, I take it?

dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: Sharp as always, hehe!

dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: Leyla told me everything he saw. Everything points towards the Mare Jivari.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So it's really the Mare Jivari? But didn't it... you know, disappear?

dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: If it had really disappeared, then it shouldn't be possible to perceive it in any way. I suspect that it was hidden by some kind of power, which would explain why Leyla could see it.

dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: But enough of that. I'm not here for the Mare Jivari either. My main target's the person who showed up in Leyla's clairvoyance...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh? So, you know who they are then, Citlali?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hmm... Wait a moment.

dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: Alright. We'll set out as soon as you're ready.

dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: He might have left some things around his camp in his hurry to leave. Let's take a look around.

dialogues.speaker: Pucli
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, if you intend to investigate this matter, please be careful! I'll return to the resort to report on the situation.

dialogues.speaker: "Tenoyollotzin"
dialogues.text: The plan went really well. I'll leave those Asha to you. Huh? Why are you still... *cough*

dialogues.speaker: "Tenoyollotzin"
dialogues.text: And so, Tenoyollotzin gathered allies from the six great tribes. Glittering like the flames of roaring wildfire, they crashed into the mountains of darkness...

dialogues.speaker: "Easybreeze Holiday Resort" Notice
dialogues.text: Our staff are undergoing field training, so this attraction is temporarily closed.
